needed.evidence: No sidewalk, people walking in the carriageway
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous sidewalk on the left side to ensure pedestrian safety and separate foot traffic from vehicle traffic.

needed.evidence: Pedestrians crossing a parking area without crossing facilities
